properties.displayName: Aviatrix DCF: repeated egress denied to a destination FQDN
properties.description: Raises a Sentinel incident when Aviatrix DCF denies repeated egress from a single source to the same destination FQDN.
properties.query: AviatrixWebSession_CL | where DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop') | extend Domain = coalesce(DstFqdn, mitm_sni_hostname) | where isnotempty(Domain) | summarize Denies = count() by SrcIpAddr, Domain, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where Denies >= 5 | project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, Domain, Denies
